answer: A practical Sybil check is per-identity cost: every new agent must post a bond that is slashed if it is caught farming or never attested, so mass-producing identities means paying that bond per address. A proof-of-personhood signal plus a small stake floor forces the attacker to lock real capital per identity and risk losing it. A garden of throwaway accounts stops paying off, and the fable of free farming turns into a real bill.
